name: Estefania Zambrana — additional son Ricardo (b. 1874)
researcher_question: Did Estefania Zambrana and her husband Antonio Beisaga of Cochabamba, Bolivia have a son named Ricardo, baptized 1874, in addition to their two known children (b. 1867 and 1877)?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 7, flag adds_son, confidence 3). RESOLVED (issue #857): FALSE MATCH (not proven) - the couple is well-documented (1870 marriage QL7X-YN65 + children 1867-1878: Fructuosa, Luis, Tomaza, Geronimo, Maria de la o) but none of their documented children is a Ricardo and no record ties the 1874 Santo Domingo Ricardo baptism to them; a parent-name match alone does not establish the son. (Corrects an earlier draft that wrongly said no marriage existed.) expected-findings.json is a polarity:avoid guard + a required documented-negative-conclusion finding.
